\section[vēgamuḷḷa]{\ml{വേഗമുള്ള} (vēgamuḷḷa) — fast}

\label{lesson:ML-C166-vegamulla}



\begin{quote}

Count eighth to eleventh. (\emph{Eṭṭāṁ}, \emph{ompatāṁ}, \emph{pattāṁ}, \emph{patinonnāṁ}.) Does \emph{-āṁ} stop there? (No: it goes on any number.)
